content: Client-side prediction + server reconciliation (Gabriel Gambetta pattern): client applies input locally immediately, sends input to server, server simulates authoritatively and returns state; client reconciles by replaying unacknowledged inputs on top of server state when correction needed. For small-scope/course projects this is often skippable in favor of simple server-authoritative + client interpolation, since perfect responsiveness is less critical than correctness and time budget.
